note: The demo's bench (GAME_SPEC §17). Every item is a cell of the one closed world; each vessel starts open to the room, full of air. loss: W/K to the room. wall_g: the wall's mass, which holds heat; wall_mm: how thick it is, which bends what is seen through it (ISO 3819's least wall for a beaker of its capacity). A burner's conductance is with its valve fully open. at: [column, row], the top-left square of its footprint on the bench's grid of squares; an item without it starts in the cabinet. The bench adds its own tray, where what overflows goes.
